integrity: The proof starts from the exact sharp-root equation in the cited theorem. Monotonicity and convergence to one are exact consequences of that equation. The asymptotic derivation first proves the required logarithmic bound on N(1-R), which justifies the subsequent exponential expansion; numerical checks are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic keeps the Schwarz-map order m and power p fixed while the tail index N tends to infinity. Joint scaling limits of m, p, and N are not classified. Only the leading Lambert-W law and its log-log expansion are claimed.
title: Lambert-W boundary layer for high-tail Bohr–Rogosinski radii
